show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A seemingly useless house-husband is humiliated, betrayed, and thrown out by his ambitious wife—only to reveal he’s the secret billionaire CEO she depended on all along. As love turns to vengeance, a high-stakes game of power, lies, and karma unfolds, exposing greed, infidelity, and the true cost of underestimating the man who sacrificed everything.
